g.text: GENERAL LAWS OF THE STATE OF TEXAS
AN ACT to provide for uniform text-books in the public free schools.
SEC. 4. That the State Text-Book Board shall, on the first Monday
in July, 1904, adopt a uniform series of text-books for the public
free schools of this State, which adoption shall continue in force
for a period of five years from the first day of September following.
SEC. 5. The books so adopted for the several branches shall be:
Arithmetic — Milne's Standard Arithmetic, American Book Co.
Grammar — Reed & Kellogg's Graded Lessons, Maynard, Merrill & Co.
History — Barnes's Brief History of the United States, Am. Book Co.
SEC. 6. No county, city or district board shall adopt any book for
the branches herein named during the life of this adoption.
